705072.name: Razorquills

705092.name: Grace

705098.name: Wingman

705099.name: Affinity

706276.name: Outlaw
706276.desc: Increases critical strike chance by 1% and reduces the Focus cost of all spells and abilities by 4%.

706278.name: Elven Quivers

706279.name: Durable Quivers

706281.name: Archery Master
706281.desc: Critical strikes with Quick Shot now generate an additional stack of Advantage.

706283.name: Hailfire

706443.name: Hidden
706443.desc: Causes your Wild Strike ability to Slow affected targets by 20% for 8 sec. Using Quick Shot on an enemy Slowed by this effect consumes it to Root them in place for 5 sec and cause 149 Naure Damage every 1 sec. Also teaches you Wargstride, and increases all Nature Damage done by 1%.

706483.name: Dastardly
706483.desc: Level 50 Passive Increases your critical damage dealt by 15% on enemies above 80% health or below 20% health.

706744.name: Venom-Dipped Blades
706744.desc: Exploit now poisons enemies, causing 120 Nature damage every 1 sec for 5 sec. Scales with attack power.

706746.name: Master Mind
706746.desc: Removes the Focus cost of Knockout.

706748.name: 'Tactical' Advantage

707094.name: Elemental Secrets

707318.name: Poison Seeds
707318.desc: Your Snapseed now applies 4 stacks of Deepwood Poison, but no longer knocks enemies back.

707380.name: Mortal Shots

707417.name: Deft Hands

707534.name: Highlander

707700.name: Accelerated Toxins
707700.desc: Your damage dealt by Deepwood Poison now benefits from your melee haste.

707885.name: Polearm Craft
707885.desc: While a polearm is equipped, your chance to trigger your Weapon Crafts and their damage dealt is increased by 25%.

707888.name: Improved Serrated Shot

770000.name: Track Beasts
770000.desc: Shows the location of all nearby beasts on the minimap.

800082.name: Roughed Up
800082.desc: Reduces Armor and parry rating based on Agility.

800083.name: Wild Strike
800083.desc: Generates 2 Advantage Strike an enemy wildly for 100% Weapon Damage plus 3. If dual wielding, deals additional Weapon Damage with your off-hand weapon.

800084.name: Briar Veil
800084.desc: Thorns and leaves swirl around you, masking your movements for 10 seconds, increasing your dodge chance by 50% and causing dodging attacks to restore 2% maximum health and 5 Focus.

800085.name: Reposition
800085.desc: Leap to the targeted location. Usable while stealthed.

800086.name: Horn of War
800086.desc: Generates 1 Advantage Emanate an aura for 30 seconds that grants 5% increased critical strike chance to party and raid members. Does not stack with similar effects. While active, you generate 3 Focus every 1 sec.

800087.name: Ranger's Horn of Coordination
800087.desc: Emanate an aura for 30 sec that increases movement speed by 40% for party members within 50 yds. All Ranger's Horn spells share a cooldown.

800088.name: Horn of Perseverance
800088.desc: Generates 1 Advantage Emanate an aura for 30 sec that reduces the resource costs of spells by 10% for party and raid members within 100 yds. While active, you generate 3 Focus every 1 sec. All Ranger's Horn spells share a cooldown.

800089.name: Adaptation: Brigand
800089.desc: Physical and Nature damage increased by 3%, ranged attack power reduced by 75%. Critical strikes with Wild Strike and Flank have a 50% chance to apply Roughed Up, reducing Armor, and Counterstruck, reducing attack power.

800093.name: Skewer
800093.desc: Generates 1 Advantage Swing your spear at all enemies in front of you dealing 200% Weapon Damage and marking them for 10 sec. You may reactivate the ability to pull all marked enemies to your location. Each enemy pulled reduces the cooldown of your Hookshot by 3 sec.

800150.name: Forest Herald
800150.desc: Casting Toxic Dart and abilities that spend stacks of Advantage now have a 20% chance to spawn a green Dreamflower at a random location nearby within 15 yds of you.

800153.name: Skewer (Pull)
800153.desc: Pull all skewered enemies to your location. Will only pull an enemy that is 40 yds away or closer.

800244.name: Strider's Blade
800244.desc: Increases the damage of party members within 25 yds by 1%, allows your melee abilities to cleave 2 enemies, and you can now use Flank as if you were in Elude. Using a ranged attack ends this effect.

800245.name: Tactician
800245.desc: Your next Whiplash grants Strider's Blade, stacking 10 times. Each stack increases the damage granted by Strider's Blade by 100% and its duration by 5 sec.

800248.name: Bushcraft - Skinning Speed
800248.desc: Allows you to skin beasts faster.

800261.name: Light Quiver
800261.desc: Increases melee and ranged haste by 10% and reduces the Focus costs of abilities by 15%. Only 1 Quiver may be active at a time. Shares a cooldown with other Quivers.

800262.name: Hunting Quiver
800262.desc: Increases your damage against Beasts and Dragonkin by 20% and your critical strike chance against them by 10%. Only 1 Quiver may be active at a time. Shares a cooldown with other Quivers.

800264.name: Hack
800264.desc: Hack an enemy dealing 91.8 Physical Damage and reducing their movement speed by 61% for 8 sec.

800266.name: Woodsman's Adaptation
800266.desc: Enhance an ally's focus, increasing their melee and ranged attack power by 30. Lasts 30 min

800267.name: Bushcraft
800267.desc: Gain the ability to craft Crude Leather from the Leather obtained from Skinning, gives you a chance to find it when Skinning beasts, and increases your Skinning speed. Allows you to craft items that require Crude Leather.

800268.name: Craft: Quilted Padding
800268.desc: Craft a Quilted Padding for an ally, increasing Stamina by 2 for 1 hour.

800269.name: Waterskin
800269.desc: Drink from an enchanted waterskin, restoring 143 health and 20% of your missing Mana or Focus.

800270.name: Rider's Harness
800270.desc: Increases your mounted movement speed by 25% for 30 min.

800271.name: Craft: Tassel Guard
800271.desc: Craft Tassel Guards for an ally, increasing their armor by 173 to 177 for 1 hour.

800272.name: Read Map
800272.desc: Allows you to locate nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap. Lasts 30 min.

800278.name: Ranger's Horn-unused
800278.desc: Emanate an aura for 15 sec that grants allies within 50yd 10% increased maximum health and heals them for 5 every 0 sec. All Ranger's Horn spells share a cooldown.

800284.name: Boots of Speed
800284.desc: Increases your Movement Speed by 100%. This works like a Mount.

800305.name: Steer Boat
800305.desc: Allows you to locate nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap. Lasts 1 min.

800358.name: Hawkeye
800358.desc: You now fire an arrow every 3 sec at enemies within 30 yds affected by your Hunting Shot, dealing 75% Ranged Weapon Damage. Scales with Hunting Shot modifiers.

800360.name: Hookshot
800360.desc: Launch a hook at a target attempting to lodge it into an open wound, dealing 80 + 100% AP Physical Damage. If the target is bleeding, you can reactivate this to pull yourself to them, dealing 150% Weapon Damage and generating 2 Advantage

800361.name: Onslaught
800361.desc: At 3 stacks, enemy movement speed is reduced by 60% for 4 sec.

800989.name: Swashbuckler
800989.desc: Increases your attack power by 15% of your Armor.

801069.name: Skirmisher's Quiver
801069.desc: Increases your Physical damage and your critical damage by 10%. Only 1 Quiver may be active at a time. Shares a cooldown with other Quivers.

801081.name: Javelin Toss
801081.desc: Toss a javelin, dealing 97 to 98 Physical damage to an enemy and causes them to bleed for an additional 19 damage every 2 sec for 16 sec. Stacks 3 times. Direct damage increased by 20% for each stack of Advantage.

801191.name: Hunting Shot
801191.desc: Fire a shot that ricochets between 3 enemies, dealing Ranged Weapon Damage plus 6 to each enemy. Generates 1 stack of Advantage for each enemy hit.

801434.name: Instinct
801434.desc: Your instinct kicks in, instantly restoring 40 Focus and increasing your attack power by 40% of your Agility for 15 sec. Usable while stealthed.

801468.name: Pinpoint Accuracy
801468.desc: Critical strikes with direct damaging abilities now generate 4 Focus.

801538.name: Ranger's Horn After Casting Script Trigger

801579.name: Empowered
801579.desc: Your next Ravage, Exploit, Hack, or Bludgeon ability within 0 is empowered, and applies Counterstruck, reducing attack power.

801980.name: Kobe Invisibility
801980.desc: Allows you to be yourself for -0.001 sec.

802036.name: Skullpiercer
802036.desc: Aim for the skull, dealing 10 Physical damage. Damage increased for each stack of Advantage.

802039.desc: Increases your ranged critical strike chance by 15% and reduces your Focus costs by -25%. Lasts 4 sec for each stack of Advantage.

802040.name: Falconmark

802041.name: Improved Falconmark
802041.desc: When you use Falcon Mark, you store 2 additional Combo Points.

802311.name: Skullpiercer Focus

802601.name: Twineweave Line

802811.name: Bushcraft Glider
802811.desc: Craft a Glider for an ally, causing them to glide while in the air and reducing their damage taken from falling for 1 hour. Not usable while in combat.

802812.desc: Craft a Waterskin, restoring health and mana to an ally. Allies may only use a Waterskin once per minute. Can be used while stealthed.

802816.name: Superior Waterskin

802817.name: Masterwork Waterskin
802817.desc: Craft a Waterskin, restoring health and mana to an ally. Allies may only use a Waterskin once per minute. Can be used while stealthed.

803103.desc: While in Elude, gain 20% increased movement speed and enable the use of abilities as if you had recently parried an attack.

803107.name: Journeyman Navigation

803108.name: Assault
803108.desc: Assault a low health enemy, dealing 100% Weapon Damage plus an additional 9 + 100% AP Physical Damage. If the target is bleeding, this deals 50% increased damage. Damage increased by 30% for each stack of Advantage. Only usable on enemies below 20% health.

803109.name: Assaulted

803675.name: 4 Bushcraft Gliders

803747.name: Verdant Quiver
803747.desc: Increases your damage against Beasts and Dragonkin by 10% and your critical strike chance against them by 5%. Only 1 Quiver may be active at a time. Shares a cooldown with other Quivers.

803851.desc: Generates 1 Advantage Ravage an enemy, causing them to bleed out dealing 80 Physical Damage over 12 seconds.

803852.name: Hooked

803871.name: Assassin

804182.name: Mighty Arbalest
804182.desc: Your Quick Shot ability fires 20% faster. Your next Ballista Shot or Skullpiercer causes 25% increased damage. Stacks 0 times.

Cultists can build toward Strength for a melee hybrid or tank playstyle, Intellect and Spell Power for a caster playstyle, or Spirit and Spell Power for a healer playstyle.

804335.name: Betrayer
804335.desc: Increases your Attack Power by 0% of your Agility, and your Spell Power by 30% of your Attack Power. Also increases your Dodge Rating by 40% of your Agility. Your off-hand damage is increased by 40%, and your successful Dodges cause you to strike your target with an off-hand weapon attack. This can only occur while in melee range of your target.

804344.name: Circle of Elements
804344.desc: Increases your Spell Power by 30% of your Attack Power.

804350.name: Bomb Specialist
804350.desc: Increases Fire spell power by 15% of Agility.

804357.name: Eternal Balance
804357.desc: Increases your Holy Spell Damage by 15% of your Agility, and your Melee Hit Rating and Expertise Rating by 25% of your Intellect. Monks can build Agility to empower their Physical and Weapon attacks, or Intellect and Spell Power to empower their Holy Damage effects. As masters of different styles of combat, monks gain special benefits when using specific weapons, and have a different primary attack based on whether they choose to fight Unarmed, with Dual Weapons, with a Staff, or with a Long Blade (Two-Handed Sword or Polearm).

804400.name: Spread Arrows

804404.name: Slinging Bolts

804478.name: Artificer's Wand
804478.desc: Transforms your Unmake into Artificer's Wand.

804513.name: Order and Chaos
804513.desc: Order and Chaos stacks will always add up to 20, empowering abilities of the same type. Reaching 20 stacks of either kind will reset them back to 10/10.

804682.name: Campsite
804682.desc: Construct a Campsite and place a Campfire nearby for 0. Allies may interact with it to become well rested for 2 hour.

804712.name: Emerald Arrow
804712.desc: Set up a powerful magical arrow and then shoot it, dealing 10 + 25% ranged AP Nature Damage to the target, increased by 20% for each stack of Advantage. Creates an enchanted flare on the ground, causing nearby enemies to take 388 + 20% ranged AP Nature Damage every 2 sec, lasting 2 sec for each stack of Advantage.

804714.name: Heavy Bolt

804725.name: Crippling Shot

804759.name: Forestwood Key

804790.name: Cure Light Leather

804791.name: Cure Medium Leather
804791.desc: Turn 1 Medium Leather into 2 Crude Leather that you can use for your craft abilities.

804792.name: Cure Heavy Leather
804792.desc: Turn 1 Heavy Leather into 3 Crude Leather that you can use for your Craft abilities.

804793.name: Cure Thick Leather
804793.desc: Turn 1 Thick Leather into 4 Crude Leather that you can use for your Craft abilities.

804794.name: Cure Rugged Leather
804794.desc: Turn 1 Rugged Leather into 5 Crude Leather that you can use for your craft abilities.

804795.name: Cure Knothide Leather
804795.desc: Turn 1 Knothide Leather into 10 Ranger's Leather that you can use for your Craft abilities.

804796.name: Cure Borean Leather
804796.desc: Turn 1 Borean Leather into 15 Ranger's Leather that you can use for your Craft abilities.

804937.name: Adaptation: Swashbuckler
804937.desc: Increases Attack Power by 15%, Parry Chance by 10% and reduces Ranged Attack Power by 50%. Successful parries have a chance to apply Counterstruck. Using Ravage allows you to use abilities that require you to parry. Can only be used with a one-handed melee weapon, and no off-hand. Only 1 Adaptation can be active at a time.

804938.name: Cannon Blast
804938.desc: Fires a cannonball at an enemy, dealing 383 to 392 Physical damage, and then an additional 56 to 58 Fire damage over 10 sec, knocking them back a short distance.

804939.name: Excessive But Necessary
804939.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Elude and Knockout by -4 sec.

804940.name: Flank
804940.desc: Generates 2 Advantage Flank an enemy from behind, taking them by surprise and dealing 150% Weapon Damage (300% if a dagger is equipped) plus 105 Physical damage.

804942.name: Underhanded Throws
804942.desc: Casting Quills now reduces the cost of subsequent Quills by 20% for 6 sec, stacking 3 times. At 3 stacks all stacks are instantly consumed to reset the cooldown of Ravage and make your next Ravage within 10 sec free of cost and generate 50 Focus.

805008.name: Infected Claws

805035.name: Infected Blood

805736.name: Adaptation: Farstrider

805737.name: Gloomstalker
805737.desc: Increases Ranged Haste by 49%, and Critical Strike Rating by 39% of Agility. Using Reposition ends this effect.

805888.name: Battle Prowess
805888.desc: Increases chance to hit with all spells and attacks by 1% for you and party and raid members. Does not stack with similar effects.

805972.name: Adaptation: Bowman
805972.desc: Increases ranged Attack Power by 0%, and ranged haste by 0%. Reduces Melee Attack Speed by 0%. Whenever you use Serrated Shot, Soaring Shot or Precision Shot you have a chance to reset the cooldown of Hail of Arrows. Only 1 Adaptation can be active at a time.

806341.name: Falcon Dive
806341.desc: Call 2 War Falcons to dive forward from your position, dealing Physical Damage to up to 3 enemies struck. The War Falcons then remain to aid you in combat for 12 sec.

806342.name: Whipvine Arrow
806342.desc: Launch an arrow with magical vines attached to it at your target, dealing 78 + 33% ranged AP Nature Damage and rooting them for 40 seconds (8 sec vs players). Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Hits 1 additional nearby target per stack of Advantage.

806359.name: Horn of Endurance
